posts.subject: Lenovo Loq Essential 15ırx11 i5-13450hx işlemci ısınma sorunu
posts.author: yilmazryucel
posts.message_html: Hello. I bought the Loq essential 15ırx11 83SC product 3 weeks ago. I am experiencing overheating problems with the device. While playing games, my processor temperature averages between 80 and 85 degrees, but it momentarily goes up to 98–99 degrees. Likewise, my RAM and SSD disk 2 temperatures also reach 80 degrees. On the GPU side, I do not have an overheating problem. These situations occur while the computer is in balanced mode. When I switch to performance mode, the temperatures increase even more, and this time I experience momentary FPS drops; it drops from 150 FPS to 40–50. During this drop, the CPU GHz falls to around 0.4; as you can understand, the processor momentarily throttles itself due to the temperatures. For this reason, I can never play games in performance mode. Through the Legion Space application, I tried setting a custom fan profile; I set the performance mode profile to default and exited without changing any settings, and this time my temperature values dropped quite a lot and became more stable, but then the FPS I got in the game also dropped and it lost its smoothness. After that, I uninstalled the Legion Space application and tried performance mode this way; in this state, I can play games in performance mode and I do not experience FPS drops or in-game stuttering, but the temperature still reaches high degrees. Since the product is still new, has it been like this since I bought it— is my product defective, or is there another problem?

As you said, I did the test and as seen in the photo, no problem could be found. All my software and drivers are up to date; I also haven’t done any modifications. I have been experiencing this issue since I bought it. 

Below I shared HwInfo tests from the game CS2. The 17-18 minute one is the result of the game I played in Balanced mode via Legion Space.

The other one, which is 3-4 minutes long, is again a screenshot of Performance mode via Legion Space. It lasted 4 minutes, yes, because I experienced FPS drops so bad that I couldn’t play.

These temperatures and FPS drops are not specific to CS2; in Valorant I also get the same FPS drops in Performance mode. In GTA5 I don’t get FPS drops, but the temperature is higher than in Balanced mode.

My product serial number: 83SC000QTR

posts.subject: Re:Lenovo Loq Essential 15ırx11 i5-13450hx processor overheating problem
posts.author: Adriel_lenovo
posts.message_html:
Thanks for getting back to us yilmazryucel,

Your CPU briefly reaching the high‑90°C range can happen on gaming laptops under burst load, but the severe FPS drops in Performance mode with the CPU clock collapsing to ~0.4 GHz (while the GPU is fine) plus very high RAM/SSD temps suggests the system may be hitting a thermal/firmware control limit and needs targeted checks. Since this has happened since day one and Lenovo diagnostics shows no error, please follow this single path:

1) Confirm cooling/airflow basics (quick but important)
- Use the laptop on a hard, flat surface (no bed/blanket).
- Make sure the rear/side exhaust vents are not blocked.
- In Windows, set screen/keyboard brightness and background apps normally (don’t run extra overlays at first).

2) Reset performance profiles and remove conflicts (Legion Space can influence power/fan curves)
- Reinstall Legion Space (from Microsoft Store/Lenovo official source), then open it and choose “Restore/Reset to default” for Thermal Mode/Fan settings (delete any custom profile).
- After resetting, reboot the PC.
- Test again in Balanced mode first for 10–15 minutes.

3) Standardize your test to identify whether it’s CPU power spikes causing the throttling
- In Windows Power Options, temporarily set:
- Power mode: “Balanced”
- Processor power management > Maximum processor state: 99% (this disables aggressive turbo boost)
- Retest the same game for 10 minutes.
- If the FPS drops disappear and CPU no longer hits ~97–99°C, the issue is likely turbo/power behavior rather than a failing part. You can then re-enable turbo and instead cap FPS (in-game or NVIDIA control panel) to keep temps stable.
- If the FPS drops still happen and CPU still collapses to ~0.4 GHz, continue to step 5.

4) Check for thermal throttling vs. power/current throttling (1 quick HWiNFO check)
- In HWiNFO sensors while the FPS drop happens, look at CPU “Thermal Throttling” and any “Power Limit/Current Limit/EDP” indicators.
- If Thermal Throttling is triggered at the same moment and clocks drop hard, cooling transfer/assembly (heatsink pressure/thermal paste/pads) can be the cause—even on a new unit.
- If it’s mainly power/current limit flags (without thermal), it points more to firmware/power control behavior.

5) High RAM/SSD temps (80–83°C) — immediate mitigation
- Ensure the area under the laptop is not trapping heat.
- Consider a simple stand/cooling pad to increase airflow.
- If the SSD temperature repeatedly reaches ~80°C during normal gaming, that’s higher than we’d like long-term; it can reduce performance and lifespan.

6) When to request service (recommended given day-one behavior)
Because you’re seeing repeatable, extreme clock drops in Performance mode and very high component temperatures since purchase, please open a warranty service request so an authorized technician can inspect the cooling assembly (heatsink seating/thermal paste/pads/fan operation) and confirm normal behavior for your unit. 

You can contact our technical support at 0212-9120-134 (Standard charges apply) and their operating hours are 9:00 - 18:00 Monday - Friday. Provide them its serial number so they can also review its warranty info.

Otherwise, you can also visit any authorized service centers in your area if you prefer in-person inspection of the unit. Don't forget to ask how their store, including their repair policy work first before you bring it in.

Thanks again,
Adriel_Lenovo

topic_info.subject: Lenovo Loq Essential 15ırx11 i5-13450hx işlemci ısınma sorunu
topic_info.message: Merhaba. Loq essential 15ırx11 83SC ürününü 3 hafta önce satın aldım. Üründe ısınma problemleri yaşıyorum. Oyun oynarken işlemci sıcaklığım ortalama 80 85 derece arasında ama anlık olarak 98 99 derecelere kadar çıkıyor. aynı şekilde ram ve ssd disk 2 sıcaklığım da 80 dereceleri görüyor. Gpu tarafında ise ısınma sıkıntısı yaşamıyorum. bu dediğim durumlar bilgisayar dengeli modda iken yaşanıyor. Performans moduna aldığımda ise sıcaklıklar daha da artıyor ve bu sefer anlık fps düşüşleri yaşıyorum 150 fps'lerden 40-50'ye kadar düşüyor bu düşme esnasında ise Cpu ghz 0.4 civarına kadar düşüyor anlayacağınız işlemci kendini anlık kısıtlıyor sıcaklıklardan ötürü. Bu yüzden oyunları asla performans modunda oynayamıyorum. Legion Space uygulaması üzerinden özel fan ayarı yapmayı denedim performans modu profilini varsayılan yapıp çıktım hiçbir ayarı değiştirmedim bu sefer sıcaklık değerlerim bayağı düştü daha stabil bir hale geldi fakat bu sefer de oyunda aldığım fps de düştü ve akıcılığını kaybetti. Bunun üzerine legion space uygulamasını sildim bu şekilde performans modunu denedim böyleyken performans modunda oyun oynayabiliyorum fps düşüşlerini oyun içi takılmaları yaşamıyorum fakat sıcaklık yine yüksek derecelere ulaşıyor. Ürün daha yeni aldığımdan beri böyle ürünüm mü hatalı yoksa başka bir sorun mu var?
